name: SunPower legacy leases/loans/PPAs (serviced by SunStrong Management)
notes: Researched from SunStrong Management's public 'Your account' page and the public log-in and Help pages of the SunPower-originated billing portal (sunstrong.youronlineaccount.com); never signed in or registered. This is a different billing site from the Sunnova accounts SunStrong also services (esp.myaccountinfo.com, tier-1 dossier sunnova-...-8f9007): SunStrong's Your account page sends SunPower lease, loan and PPA customers to sunstrong.youronlineaccount.com. Log In uses Username and Password; the first log-in from a new device asks for a code sent by email. Register Now asks for personal information plus the account number or SSN, then a User ID and password. Statements arrive about 20 days before the due date and are under Manage Account > Account Documents; paper statements can be chosen in the portal (paperless supported). Payments online are from a checking or savings account only (credit cards are not accepted); also bank bill pay, mail (PO Box 845073, Dallas, TX 75284-5073), phone and wire. No daily payment limit. AutoPay can be set up online or by phone and cancelled with at least three business days' notice before the scheduled date; electronic payments carry a $7.50 monthly discount (not modelled as a fee). Due date can be changed to any day except the 29th-31st (not expressible). Leases have a 10-day grace period, then a late fee (amount not published). Loans: first payment about two months after installation, re-amortization 18 months after installation, payoff quotes in the portal, no prepayment penalty; leases: buyout quotes online or by phone. Home sale or refinance: call or send a secure message. Customer service (833) 514-1858, Mon-Fri 7am-9pm CT per the Help page header (answers say 7am-7pm CST).

autopay_cancel.note: Cancel automatic payments at least three business days before the scheduled payment date. Keeping electronic payments gives you a $7.50 monthly discount.

cancel_service.note: Your solar agreement stays with the home. If you are selling or refinancing your home, or want a payoff or buyout quote, call SunStrong Management at (833) 514-1858 or send a secure message after logging in.

help.title: How do I make a payment?
paragraphs: The easiest way is to log in and pay from a checking or savings account. Credit cards are not accepted at this time.

You can also pay through your bank's online bill pay (check that your bank doesn't charge a fee), mail a payment to SunStrong Management, PO Box 845073, Dallas, TX 75284-5073, or call (833) 514-1858. Wire transfers are accepted by arrangement with Customer Service.
There is no limit on how much you can pay in one day. Extra or advance payments can be made online or by phone.

help.title: Automatic payments
paragraphs: You can set up automatic payments online or by calling (833) 514-1858.
You may cancel automatic payments with at least three business days' notice before your scheduled payment date. Staying on electronic payments keeps your $7.50 monthly discount.

help.title: Billing questions
paragraphs: Your statement arrives about 20 days before your payment due date. View every statement under Manage Account, then Account Documents. You can choose paper statements in the portal.
Lease payments have a 10-day grace period; a payment not posted within it incurs a late fee.
You can change your monthly due date to any day except the 29th, 30th or 31st (not your first payment).
Your SunStrong invoice is separate from your utility bill, so you will still get a bill from your utility.

help.title: Selling, refinancing or paying off
paragraphs: If you are selling or refinancing your home, call (833) 514-1858 or send a secure message after logging in, as early as possible.
Loans can be paid off at any time with no prepayment penalty; generate a payoff quote in the portal. Lease customers can request a buyout quote online or by phone.
The UCC fixture filing on a loan secures SunStrong's interest in the solar system; it is not a lien on your home.

help.title: Contact SunStrong Management
paragraphs: Call (833) 514-1858, Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Central time (7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Central for Connecticut and Nevada).
Send a secure message after logging in, or write to SunStrong Management, PO Box 91910, Sioux Falls, SD 57109-1910.
